title: CGLMP on maximally entangled states: exact optimality, rigidity and Tsirelson bounds
description: Computer-assisted proofs for the CGLMP Bell inequality (IQOQI Vienna Open Quantum Problem 27B). For d = 3..12, exact sum-of-squares certificates over cyclotomic fields show that the Durt-Kaszlikowski-Zukowski measurements are optimal for CGLMP_d on maximally entangled states of any local dimension, and that they are rigid: any optimal strategy is DKZ tensored with an identity, up to local unitaries. The algebraic core of rigidity is machine-checked in Lean 4 with Mathlib for all d. Exact Tsirelson bounds over all states are certified for d = 3..8 (new for d = 5..8), and the Kullback-Leibler optimality claim for the DKZ measurements is shown to fail for d = 4..9 with certified intervals. The repository contains the certificates, independent exact checkers, the Lean formalisation and all verification logs.
